name: com.reacho.flexibleuitool
description: One UI prefab for portrait, square and landscape screens. Profile layouts are stored as data on the prefab and switched at runtime by aspect ratio. Includes Layout / Preview / Review editor windows (English, Korean, Japanese) and a command line for coding agents.

samples.description: FlexibleSample prefab, SampleScene with a Flexible Canvas Scaler, and default profile settings. Used by the tutorials in MANUAL.md and AGENTS.md.
